item.description: This offense had been set to 2nd gear for most of the season. item.title: Selection As Heisman Finalist “Surreal” for Julian Sayin, Even if Big Ten Championship Game Disappointment Lingers
item.description: The realization of a lifelong dream feels sweeter than words can express, even if it comes after bitter disappointment. item.title: 61 Ohio State Football Players Earn Academic All-Big Ten Honors, Including Most of Team’s Top Stars
item.description: More than half of Ohio State’s 2025 football players are Academic All-Big Ten honorees. item.title: Former Michigan Coach Sherrone Moore In Jail, Under Investigation for Alleged Assault Hours After Firing from Michigan
item.description: Sherrone Moore is under investigation for an alleged assault that occurred on the same afternoon he was fired by Michigan. The Pittsfield Township Police Department confirmed Wednesday night in a media release that it is investigating an alleged assault by Moore and that the now-former Michigan coach was in custody at the Washtenaw County Jail pending review of charges by the Washtenaw County Prosecutor. item.title: Ohio State Has Three Players in Top Nine of Heisman Trophy Vote As Jeremiah Smith Finishes 6th, Caleb Downs Finishes 9th
item.description: Three Ohio State players finished in the top nine of this year’s Heisman Trophy vote. Ohio State wide receiver Jeremiah Smith finished sixth and Ohio State safety Caleb Downs finished ninth in this year’s Heisman Trophy balloting, ESPN revealed Thursday night during a show unveiling the fifth-through-10th-place finishers in the 2025 Heisman Trophy vote. The fifth through 10th spots in the 2025 Heisman balloting were released tonight on The Top 10 Heisman Trophy Finalists Show Presented by @nissa
